verdict.rationale: Fly.io markets 'Sprites'—persistent, checkpointable VMs that sleep/wake and let agents like Claude/Codex run and resume autonomously in the background, which directly supports agentic background automation (fly-io-docs-4,5,6,9). However, community feedback notes Fly lacks a built-in scheduler/cron primitive, forcing users to build their own always-on scheduler app, and reports frequent reliability/outage issues that undercut trust for unattended autonomous workloads (fly-io-comm-20, fly-io-comm-1–9,17,19).
